item.title: Capitals come back from holiday break with a clutch win: numbers for the morning after
item.description: The Washington Capitals went back and forth with a very game New Jersey Devils team on Saturday night. The Caps battled periods of very poor play throughout the night, but countered with just as many great stretches that helped them to a 4-3 overtime victory. Great to see two points right out of the break.

item.title: Cole Eiserman held Cole Hutson’s hand as he lay on the ice injured and couldn’t move: ‘I tried to make sure he was able to squeeze it’
item.description: Washington Capitals prospect Cole Hutson was stretchered off the ice at the 2026 World Junior Championship on Saturday after being struck in the back of the head by a shot. Hutson immediately fell to the ice and needed to be immobilized on a backboard before he was transported by ambulance to a local Minnesota hospital.
